title: Joy & Gratitude
intro: Joy is not the same as everything going well, and a child who learns that early is given something they keep for life. This month is about noticing — what is good, who is good, and how much of an ordinary day is worth saying thank you for.

keyScriptures.text: This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you.

weeks.title: Joy Is Not the Same as Getting Your Way
weeks.declaration: Happy comes and goes with the day. Joy is deeper down, and it does not depend on everything going the way you wanted.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, plant a joy in our child that the day cannot take. Let it be deeper than their circumstances. Amen.

weeks.title: Noticing
weeks.declaration: Gratitude starts with noticing. Most of the good in a day goes past unremarked, and it does not have to.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, teach our whole family to notice. Make our table a place where good things get named out loud. Amen.

weeks.title: Saying Thank You
weeks.declaration: Thank you is a small sentence that changes the person saying it. It is worth saying often and out loud.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, make our child someone who says thank you and means it. Let gratitude become their habit rather than their manners. Amen.

weeks.title: Glad to Be Here
weeks.declaration: You are allowed to enjoy your life. Delight is not a distraction from serious things — God invented it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, let our child be genuinely glad. Give them laughter in this house that they remember when they are grown. Amen.

days.title: Today Was Made
days.declaration: Today was made on purpose, and it was made for you to be in. That is worth being glad about.

scripture.text: This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

days.title: Joy Is Deeper Than Happy
days.declaration: Happy comes and goes with the weather. Joy sits underneath, and it stays.

scripture.text: The joy of the Lord is your strength.

days.title: Notice One Good Thing
days.declaration: There is at least one good thing in today. Find it, and say it out loud.

scripture.text: Whatever is true, whatever is noble... think about such things.

days.title: Thank You Changes You
days.declaration: Saying thank you does something to the person saying it. It is worth the small effort.

scripture.text: Give thanks in all circumstances.

days.title: Good Gifts
days.declaration: Every good thing in your life came from somewhere. None of it is accidental.

scripture.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above.

days.title: Laughing Is Allowed
days.declaration: God made laughter. Enjoying your life is not a distraction from serious things.

scripture.text: A cheerful heart is good medicine.

days.title: Small Things Count
days.declaration: Warm food, a friend, a bed, someone who knows your name. Small things are most of a good life.

scripture.text: Praise the Lord... and forget not all his benefits.

days.title: Even on Hard Days
days.declaration: You can be grateful on a hard day. It does not mean the hard part was not real.

scripture.text: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord.

days.title: Thanking People
days.declaration: Tell people thank you while they can hear it. Do not save it up.

scripture.text: And be thankful.

days.title: You Have Enough Today
days.declaration: You have enough today. Being grateful is partly just noticing that.

scripture.text: Godliness with contentment is great gain.

days.title: Wanting Less
days.declaration: Wanting everything makes you enjoy nothing. Wanting less is a way of getting more out of what you have.

scripture.text: Be content with what you have.

days.title: Singing
days.declaration: Singing changes how a room feels and how you feel in it. Sing anyway, even badly.

scripture.text: Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.

days.title: Joy in the Middle of a Mess
days.declaration: Joy does not wait for everything to be tidy. It can turn up in the middle of a mess.

scripture.text: No one will take away your joy.

days.title: Someone Else's Good News
days.declaration: Being glad for someone else's win makes your life bigger, not smaller.

scripture.text: Rejoice with those who rejoice.

days.title: Say It at Dinner
days.declaration: Name one good thing from your day at the table. It is a habit that will outlast childhood.

scripture.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.

days.title: Ungrateful Days
days.declaration: Some days you will not feel grateful. Say thank you anyway; the feeling often follows.

scripture.text: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Put your hope in God.

days.title: Made to Enjoy
days.declaration: God did not have to make strawberries taste nice or make you laugh. He wanted you to enjoy being alive.

scripture.text: God, who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.

days.title: Grateful for People
days.declaration: People are the best gifts. Notice the ones you have been given.

scripture.text: I thank my God every time I remember you.

days.title: Not Comparing
days.declaration: Comparing what you have to what someone else has is the fastest way to lose your joy.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions.

days.title: Thank You Before It Comes
days.declaration: You can thank God before you can see how it works out. That is what trust sounds like.

scripture.text: With thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

days.title: Delight
days.declaration: God delights in you. That is a reason to be glad that has nothing to do with today going well.

scripture.text: He will rejoice over you with singing.

days.title: Enjoying What You Do
days.declaration: You are allowed to enjoy what you are good at. That is not showing off.

scripture.text: There is nothing better for a person than to enjoy their work.

days.title: Remembering
days.declaration: Remembering good things that have already happened is a way of being glad twice.

scripture.text: I will remember the deeds of the Lord.

days.title: Grateful for Your Body
days.declaration: Your body carries you through every day. Thank God for what it can do rather than measuring it.

scripture.text: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

days.title: Joy Is Contagious
days.declaration: Cheerful people change rooms. You can be the one who lifts the mood rather than the one who lowers it.

scripture.text: A cheerful look brings joy to the heart.

days.title: Thankful for Second Chances
days.declaration: Every morning is a second chance. That alone is worth a thank you.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Give Some Away
days.declaration: Giving something away makes you gladder than keeping it. This is strange and true.

scripture.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

days.title: The Best Is Not Behind
days.declaration: Whatever good has happened, more is coming. God does not run out of good things.

scripture.text: No good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

days.title: Grateful for Home
days.declaration: Somewhere to come back to is a real gift. Not everyone has one, and you do.

scripture.text: God sets the lonely in families.

days.title: Joy That Nobody Takes
days.declaration: There is a kind of joy that nobody can take off you, because it did not come from them.

scripture.text: And no one will take away your joy.

days.title: Carry the Noticing
days.declaration: The noticing you have practised this month works in every month. Keep doing it.

scripture.text: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances.
